## Checklist

- [ ] `./mvnw verify` passes (tests, coverage gate, Spotless, Checkstyle, SpotBugs)
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; a fixed bug has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...)
- [ ] Docs updated if the change affects rules, patterns or the configuration format
